articles.title: 6:30 Is Still on the Phone
articles.summary: Ye Ning needs to catch an early train and drags the morning heating schedule from 7:00 to 6:30. The old interface immediately shows “Next: 6:30” for the draft state, so she plans her morning as if the change has already taken effect. The device still follows 7:00. Later, when the draft schedule, current home schedule, and deployment confirmation are shown separately, her prediction changes with the visible system feedback.
articles.summaryZh: 叶宁要赶早班火车，把晨间供暖从7:00拖到6:30；旧界面立即用“下一次6:30”反馈草稿状态，使她按已生效来安排行程。实际设备仍执行7:00。她后来看到草稿计划、住宅当前计划与下发确认被分开呈现，预测才随界面反馈一起改变。
storyParagraphs: On Sunday night, Ye Ning needs to catch an early train the next morning and wants the bedroom heating to start at 6:30 instead of 7:00. She drags the schedule block half an hour to the left on her phone, and the top card immediately changes to “Next: 6:30.” She sets her alarm for 6:20, puts her scarf and train ticket over the back of a chair, and goes to sleep with her morning arranged around the new time.

When the 6:20 alarm rings, the radiator is still cool. She does not immediately decide what is wrong and continues getting ready. At 6:35 she touches it again and it is still not warming; only at 7:00 does she hear the valve operate. Before leaving, she opens the app. The timeline still sits at 6:30 and the “Next: 6:30” card is still there. What the phone displays and what the home actually executes are clearly not the same thing.

After returning home that evening, she opens the device details and finally sees two entries at the same time: the schedule being edited is 6:30, while the home’s current schedule remains 7:00. “Apply to home” has not been executed. The old interface updated the draft when she dragged the block, but it also immediately changed the top card to “Next: 6:30,” so the night before she naturally treated it as an already deployed result. She puts a screenshot of this details page beside the previous night’s top card and can finally see that the two screens were describing different states.

The product team does not simply make the word “Apply” larger. The timeline still allows tentative changes, but the draft always carries a visible “Not applied” label, while the main device card continues to show the home’s current schedule. When Ye Ning drags it to 6:30 again, the main card stays at 7:00, so she keeps the phone open and completes the deployment. Only after “Applied 21:42” appears does the current home schedule change from 7:00 to 6:30.

The next morning the alarm still rings at 6:20, and the radiator is cool. Ye Ning gets up and washes as usual. At 6:35 she touches it again; the metal surface is warm. The phone’s main card reads “Current home schedule 6:30,” with the previous evening’s 21:42 application time below. She compares this page with yesterday’s screenshot: yesterday the top card said 6:30 while the details still showed 7:00; today the current schedule and application record agree, and the heating has started in the new period.
She puts the phone back beside the bed with the current-schedule page still lit. The previous evening’s “Not applied” label is gone, leaving 6:30 and the application time.
storyParagraphsZh: 周日晚，叶宁第二天要赶早班火车，想把卧室暖气从7:00提前到6:30。她在手机里把日程块往左拖半小时，顶部马上显示“下一次6:30”。她按这个时间把闹钟定到6:20，把围巾和车票放在椅背上，便去睡了。
6:20闹钟响时，暖气片还是凉的。她没有立刻判断出问题，只按原计划洗漱；6:35再摸，仍没有升温，直到7:00才听见阀门动作。出门前她打开应用，时间轴仍停在6:30，那张“下一次6:30”也还在，手机显示与屋里真正执行的计划明显不是同一回事。
晚上回家，她点进设备详情，才看见页面深处同时存在两项：正在编辑的草稿是6:30，住宅当前计划仍是7:00。旁边的“应用到住宅”尚未执行。旧界面拖动后更新的是草稿，却把顶部卡片也立即写成“下一次6:30”，于是她昨晚自然把它当成了已经下发的结果。她把这个详情页截下来，和前一晚的顶部卡片放在一起，才看见两个页面其实在说不同状态。
团队改版时没有只把“应用”按钮放大。他们让时间轴继续允许试改，但草稿旁始终显示“尚未应用”；设备主卡只显示住宅当前计划。叶宁再次拖到6:30时，主卡仍是7:00，她没有收起手机，而是继续完成下发。成功后出现“已应用 21:42”，住宅当前计划才从7:00切成6:30。
第二天闹钟仍在6:20响，暖气片还凉着。叶宁照常起床洗漱；到6:35，她再摸了一下，金属表面已经温热。床头的手机主卡显示“住宅当前计划6:30”，下面保留着昨晚21:42的应用时间。她把这个页面与前一天存下的截图对照：昨天顶部写着6:30，详情却还是7:00；今天当前计划和下发记录已经对上，暖气也在新的时段开始工作。
她把手机放回床头，当前计划页面还亮着。前一晚那条“尚未应用”提示已经消失，留下6:30和昨晚的下发时间。
articles.conceptNameZh: 人机交互中的心智模型
explanationParagraphs: A mental model is a simplified explanation a user forms about a system’s structure and behavior in order to predict outcomes. It is usually incomplete, can change with experience and feedback, and may differ from the designer’s implementation model.

Here the old interface presents the 6:30 draft as “Next: 6:30” while the home still executes 7:00. The redesign separates the draft, current schedule, and applied confirmation so the user can revise her prediction from visible state.
explanationParagraphsZh: 心智模型是用户对系统结构和行为形成的简化解释，用于预测操作结果；它通常不完整，会随经验和反馈修改，也可能不同于设计者的实现模型。
本例旧界面把草稿6:30呈现成“下一次6:30”，而住宅仍执行7:00。改版把草稿、当前计划与已应用确认分开，使用户能据可见状态修正预测。
articles.overallZh: 这段虚构的晨间供暖经历说明人机交互中的心智模型：用户根据经验和可见反馈解释系统，并据此安排下一步。设计者熟悉草稿与设备计划的区别，不等于用户已理解；把两种状态和下发确认显示清楚，才能帮助用户修正预测。

moduleZh.intro: 草稿、设备当前计划与下发确认是三种不同信息；如果界面把它们混成一张“下一次”卡片，用户会按错误预测安排早晨。
moduleZh.diagramTitle: 从拖动6:30到真正应用，哪几个可见状态必须分开
diagramSteps: 用户为赶火车把7:00拖到6:30并按此安排早晨
旧界面立即显示下一次6:30，但住宅仍执行7:00
设备详情揭示草稿6:30与当前计划7:00同时存在
改版把未应用草稿、住宅当前计划和下发确认分别显示
成功应用后当前计划变6:30，次日6:35观察到暖气已温热
diagramStepNotes: 6:20只是起床时刻，不被误写成6:30计划已经生效的证据。
旧系统按既有实现保存草稿，但反馈容易被解释成已部署状态。
用户在详情页看见两种状态，并用暖气的实际启动时间核对原来的预测。
“已应用 21:42”提供一次明确的下发确认。
最终观察与6:30计划时间一致，不提前于计划生效时点。
mapping: 6:20闹钟与车票 → 用户真正依赖供暖计划的生活任务。
旧“下一次6:30”卡片 → 把草稿误呈现成完成状态的反馈。
住宅当前计划7:00 → 与用户预测冲突的真实状态。
“已应用21:42” → 草稿转为设备状态的明确确认。
moduleZh.boundary: 心智模型不是完整内部实现，也不意味着用户愚蠢。界面文案、故障和注意力都可能造成错误；本例只说明在系统按其既有实现运行时，持续可见反馈如何塑造错误预测。一次改版也不保证所有用户都形成相同理解。
moduleZh.reflection: 为什么旧界面的“下一次6:30”会让叶宁合理地提前安排早晨，而新的“尚未应用＋当前计划＋已应用时间”会改变她下一步操作？

referencesZh.citation: Norman, D. A. (1983). Some observations on mental models. In Mental Models (D. Gentner & A. L. Stevens, eds.).
referencesZh.use: 支持区分设计者对系统的模型、系统向用户呈现的形象与用户形成的心智模型，以及用户模型通常是不完整且可修正的。

referencesZh.citation: Chan, M. (2024). Mental Models. Nielsen Norman Group. Updated from Jakob Nielsen’s 2010 article; reviewed September 1, 2026.
referencesZh.use: 支持用户既有经验与界面反馈会影响其预测和行为，并提供面向交互设计实践的现代解释。

articles.overall: This fictional morning-heating experience illustrates mental models in human-computer interaction. Users interpret a system through experience and visible feedback, then plan their next actions accordingly. A designer’s familiarity with drafts and device schedules does not ensure the user understands them. Showing those states and application confirmation distinctly helps users revise their predictions.

module.intro: The draft, current device schedule, and application confirmation provide different information. Combining them into one “Next” card can lead the user to plan the morning around an incorrect prediction.
module.diagramTitle: From Dragging to 6:30 to Actually Applying It, Which Visible States Need to Stay Separate?
diagramSteps: To catch a train, the user drags 7:00 to 6:30 and plans the morning around it
The old interface immediately displays Next: 6:30, while the home still executes 7:00
Device details reveal that draft 6:30 and current schedule 7:00 coexist
The redesign separately displays the unapplied draft, current home schedule, and deployment confirmation
After successful application the current schedule becomes 6:30, and at 6:35 the next morning the radiator is observed to be warm
diagramStepNotes: 6:20 is only the wake-up time and is not misused as evidence that a 6:30 schedule has already taken effect.
The old system saves the draft according to its implementation, but the feedback is easy to interpret as deployed state.
The details page exposes both states, and the user checks the earlier prediction against the radiator’s actual start time.
“Applied 21:42” supplies an explicit deployment confirmation.
The final observation occurs after the 6:30 scheduled start, not before it.
mapping: 6:20 alarm and train ticket → the real-life task that makes the 6:30 setting matter.
Old “Next: 6:30” card → visible feedback that presents a draft like a completed state.
Current home schedule 7:00 → the real system state that conflicts with the user’s prediction.
“Applied 21:42” → explicit confirmation that the draft became device state.
module.boundary: A mental model is not a complete internal copy of the system, and having an incorrect one does not mean the user is foolish. Wording, faults, and attention can also cause mistakes; this example focuses only on how persistent visible feedback can shape an incorrect prediction while the system operates according to its existing implementation. One redesign also does not guarantee that every user will form the same understanding.
module.reflection: Why does the old “Next: 6:30” reasonably lead Ye Ning to plan her morning as if the change is active, while “Not applied + current schedule + application time” changes what she does next?

references.citation: Norman, D. A. (1983). Some observations on mental models. In Mental Models (D. Gentner & A. L. Stevens, eds.).
references.use: Supports distinguishing the designer’s model of a system, the system image presented to the user, and the mental model formed by the user, including the fact that user models are usually incomplete and revisable.

references.citation: Chan, M. (2024). Mental Models. Nielsen Norman Group. Updated from Jakob Nielsen’s 2010 article; reviewed September 1, 2026.
references.use: Supports the role of prior experience and interface feedback in shaping user predictions and behavior, providing a modern applied explanation for interaction design.

articles.title: Friday’s Bookmark
articles.summary: A design studio maintains two event projects, and both legitimately contain a file named final.pdf. Ye Tong uses the full parent-child path to complete the RiverFest print delivery. After the client confirms the project is finished, she manually moves the project directory from Active to Archive; the file remains, but the old path stops working. A business asset number helps the team update its location record, but it is not treated as a permanent file-system identity.
articles.summaryZh: 设计工作室同时维护两个活动项目，两边都合法地有final.pdf。叶桐用完整父子路径完成河畔节印刷交付；客户确认项目完成后，她手动把项目目录从Active移入Archive，文件仍在但旧路径失效。业务资产号帮助团队更新位置记录，却不被当作文件系统永久身份。
storyParagraphs: On Friday morning, the studio needs to send the RiverFest poster to the printer. Searching the shared drive for “final.pdf” returns two results, one for RiverFest and one for NightMarket. Neither name is wrong. The printer will lock the layout in ten minutes. Ye Tong expands both search results to see their project directories; today’s delivery is the RiverFest file.

She walks down from the shared-drive project root one component at a time: Active → Clients → RiverFest → 2026 → Print → final.pdf. The NightMarket file is at Active → Clients → NightMarket → 2026 → Print → final.pdf. The full path carries the project, year, and purpose together. She also opens the RiverFest file to verify the event date and layout before sending that version to the printer. The printer returns a proof later that day, and production starts after the client approves it.

The following Tuesday, the finished materials have been delivered and the client has confirmed that the project is complete. The project manager asks Ye Tong to archive it. She manually moves the entire Active → Clients → RiverFest → 2026 directory to Archive → Clients → RiverFest → 2026. After the move, she clicks the path she bookmarked on Friday and the system reports that the location does not exist. Entering through the new Archive path still reaches final.pdf, and its contents have not changed merely because the directory moved.

In the project register, the poster has the business asset number RF-P-014. Ye Tong opens that row, changes its path field from Active to Archive, and follows the new location from the register. Neither the filename nor the asset number changes. Colleagues looking through the project record will find the updated path. The old bookmark stores the earlier address; editing the register does not update that bookmark too.

RiverFest and NightMarket also share one sponsor logo. Ye Tong opens it through the references in both project records, checks that they point to the same source file, and keeps each project’s tags. If the source file moves later, both links will need updating. The administrator separately checks permissions and retention against the system configuration. The directory tree still gives the files their respective locations.

A scan of the print proof that was already approved on Friday is placed in the archive as well. Ye Tong opens Archive → Clients → RiverFest → 2026 → Print one last time and sees both final.pdf and the proof there. The Active path she bookmarked on Friday still does not open.
storyParagraphsZh: 周五上午，设计工作室要把河畔节海报送去印刷。共享盘里搜“final.pdf”正好出现两个：河畔节和夜市各有一份，两个名字都没写错。印刷店十分钟后锁版。叶桐把两条搜索结果展开，先看它们各在哪个项目目录；今天要交的是河畔节那份。

她从共享盘项目根目录逐段进入Active → Clients → RiverFest → 2026 → Print → final.pdf。夜市那份则在Active → Clients → NightMarket → 2026 → Print → final.pdf。完整路径把项目、年份和用途一起带出来；她再打开河畔节文件核对日期和版面，才把这一份交给印刷店。当天打印店回传样张，客户确认后进入生产。
下周二，成品已交付，客户也确认项目结束。项目经理让叶桐归档，她手动把整个Active → Clients → RiverFest → 2026目录移动到Archive → Clients → RiverFest → 2026。移动完成后，她点周五收藏的旧路径，系统提示位置不存在；沿Archive新路径进去，final.pdf仍在，内容没有因为目录搬动而改变。
项目表里，这张海报的业务资产号是RF-P-014。叶桐打开那一行，把路径栏从Active改成Archive，再从表里点进新位置。文件名和资产号都没改；同事以后按项目记录查找，会读到更新后的路径。旧收藏存的是原来的地址，不会因为她改了项目表就一起改变。
河畔节和夜市还共用同一份赞助商Logo。叶桐沿两个项目记录中的引用打开它，确认都指向同一份来源文件，再保留各自的标签。以后来源文件若移动，这两处链接也需要更新。管理员另外核对权限和保存期限，按系统实际配置处理，目录树仍只负责把文件放在各自位置。
周五已经批准的印刷样张扫描件也被一并放进归档目录。叶桐最后打开Archive → Clients → RiverFest → 2026 → Print，final.pdf和样张都在；周五收藏的Active路径仍然打不开。
explanationParagraphs: Hierarchical information organization places objects in nested directories through parent-child relationships. Paths are resolved component by component, so the same name can represent different locations under different parent directories.

A path is not a stable identity: moving a file or a parent directory changes the path and can break old references. Business IDs, tags, permissions, and retention rules are separate mechanisms and cannot be inferred automatically from directory hierarchy.
explanationParagraphsZh: 层级化信息组织通过父子关系把对象放入嵌套目录，路径按组件逐段解析，因此相同名称在不同父目录下可以表示不同位置。
路径不是稳定身份：移动文件或父目录会改变路径并使旧引用失效。业务编号、标签、权限和保存规则是其他机制，不能由目录层级自动推出。

articles.overallZh: 本篇用虚构设计工作流说明层级化信息组织：父子目录和逐段路径为对象位置提供上下文，使同名文件可以在不同分支中准确区分。路径会随人工移动或重命名而改变，因此适合表示位置而非永久身份；跨项目引用、权限和保存规则仍需其他机制维护。

moduleZh.intro: 用两个合法同名文件和一次明确的归档移动，检查完整路径怎样提供上下文，以及为什么旧路径会失效。
moduleZh.diagramTitle: 同名文件怎样靠路径区分，归档后又为什么换了位置
diagramSteps: 在RiverFest和NightMarket项目中各保留final.pdf
沿Active → Clients → RiverFest → 2026 → Print逐段定位并完成印刷交付
客户确认项目结束后，人工把RiverFest/2026整体移到Archive
验证旧Active路径失效，而Archive新路径仍能找到原文件
更新业务记录中的路径，并分别维护跨项目引用、权限和保存规则
diagramStepNotes: 同名并不等于命名错误，父目录提供上下文。
逐段解析要求每一级目录组件都匹配。
归档是项目结束后的人工操作，不是分类自动发生。
路径变化表示位置表达改变，不表示文件内容消失。
RF-P-014是工作室业务记录键，不是inode或全球永久文件身份。
mapping: 两个final.pdf → 同名对象在不同项目分支中并存。
Active与Archive路径 → 同一业务文件在不同阶段的位置。
失效的旧收藏 → 父目录移动后原路径不再解析。
RF-P-014和Logo引用 → 路径之外仍需维护的业务引用关系。
moduleZh.boundary: 层级主要组织位置，不能表达所有关系。路径可因移动或重命名改变；文件系统内部标识也有作用域和复用限制，不能简单当成全球永久ID。跨项目引用仍需维护，权限与保存期限是否继承则取决于具体系统配置。
moduleZh.reflection: 为什么两个final.pdf都可以是正确文件名，而同一文件从Active移到Archive后，内容仍在却会让旧收藏路径失效？

referencesZh.citation: Linux man-pages. path_resolution(7), man-pages 6.19 (2026).
referencesZh.use: 支持路径从根目录或当前目录开始逐组件解析，以及目录层级在实际路径查找中的语义。

referencesZh.citation: Linux man-pages. inode(7), man-pages 6.19 (2026).
referencesZh.use: 支持区分文件系统对象属性、inode编号和路径/链接，说明路径不应被当作永久身份。

articles.overall: Hierarchical information organization is illustrated here through a fictional design workflow: parent-child directories and component-by-component paths provide location context, allowing identically named files to be distinguished accurately across branches. Paths change when items are manually moved or renamed, so they represent location rather than permanent identity; cross-project references, permissions, and retention rules require other mechanisms.

module.intro: Use two legitimately identical filenames and one explicit archive move to check how a full path supplies context and why the old path fails afterward.
module.diagramTitle: How Identical Filenames Are Distinguished by Paths, and Why Archiving Changes the Location
diagramSteps: Keep a final.pdf in both the RiverFest and NightMarket projects
Follow Active → Clients → RiverFest → 2026 → Print component by component to locate and deliver the correct file
After the client confirms the project is complete, manually move RiverFest/2026 into Archive
Verify that the old Active path fails while the new Archive path still reaches the original file
Update the path in the business record and maintain cross-project references, permissions, and retention rules separately
diagramStepNotes: Identical names are not necessarily naming errors; parent directories provide context.
Component-by-component resolution succeeds only when each directory component matches.
Archiving is a deliberate action after project completion, not an automatic consequence of classification.
A changed path means the location expression changed, not that the file contents disappeared.
RF-P-014 is a studio business-record key, not an inode or a globally permanent file identity.
mapping: Two final.pdf files → identically named objects coexisting in different project branches.
Active and Archive paths → locations of the same business file at different project stages.
Broken old bookmark → the previous path no longer resolves after the parent directory moves.
RF-P-014 and logo references → business relationships that still need mechanisms beyond the path.
module.boundary: Hierarchy primarily organizes location and cannot express every relationship. Paths can change after moves or renames; internal file-system identifiers also have scope and reuse limits and should not simply be treated as globally permanent IDs. Cross-project references still require maintenance, while permission and retention inheritance depend on the specific system configuration.
module.reflection: Why can both files legitimately be named final.pdf, while moving one from Active to Archive leaves its contents intact but makes the old bookmarked path fail?

references.citation: Linux man-pages. path_resolution(7), man-pages 6.19 (2026).
references.use: Supports component-by-component path resolution from a root or current directory and the practical semantics of directory hierarchy during path lookup.

references.citation: Linux man-pages. inode(7), man-pages 6.19 (2026).
references.use: Supports distinguishing file-system object attributes and inode numbers from paths and links, helping show why a path should not be treated as permanent identity.

articles.title: The Last Photo Finishes Uploading at 17:54
articles.summary: A weekend photographer needs to keep uploading and replacing his own event photos during a 48-hour window. The team first compares the server-side result of the same out-of-scope request under a site-wide administrator role and a narrow role in a test environment. The production account is then granted only read, upload, and own-file replacement access within the event upload area, and all access is revoked at 18:00 Sunday.
articles.summaryZh: 周末摄影师需要在48小时内持续上传并替换自己提交的活动照片。团队先在测试环境比较同一越界请求在整站管理员与窄角色下的服务端结果，再正式只发放活动上传区的读取、上传和替换本人文件权限；周日18:00权限完全撤回。
storyParagraphs: At 18:00 on Friday, the brand event has just started and photographer Shao Yuan has already filled his first memory card. The weekend editors are all on site, so he needs to keep sending photographs into the “Autumn Event” upload area himself and must also be able to replace a photo he has just uploaded incorrectly. To avoid approval delays, the team had planned to issue site-wide content-administrator access, but Lin Xi decides to walk through the boundary in the test environment first.

The test site contains dummy folders and dummy images. Using his own test identity, Shao Yuan completes the normal flow: read the Autumn Event upload area, upload a new image, and replace a test photo owned by his account with a new version. Lin Xi then uses the same authenticated identity and the same prepared request to attempt deletion of the parent “Past Events” directory. Under the broad administrator role, the server’s authorization precheck returns “deletion allowed.” The test stops at that precheck without deleting either dummy folders or production material.

The team then changes that same test identity to a narrow role. It can read the Autumn Event upload area, upload new files, and replace files uploaded by that identity that still belong to the same event. It cannot delete the parent directory, enter other events, manage users, or edit product pages. The exact same out-of-scope deletion request now receives a server-side denial at the authorization precheck. Lin Xi places the two server-precheck results beside the normal upload record: the same identity and directory request changed from allowed to denied.

Only after the normal workflow also succeeds again does Lin Xi create the production temporary account. Its permissions match the narrow role and run from Friday 18:00 to Sunday 18:00, exactly 48 hours. The test administrator account is disabled before the production account goes live. If the task temporarily expands beyond the defined scope, the extra action must go through a separate time-limited elevation request.

The network is slow on Saturday, but Shao Yuan can still upload continuously and replace his own incorrect files without waiting for an editor on every image. At 17:54 on Sunday, he completes the final event-photo upload. At 17:57 he reopens one of his own files and can still check it normally; the assignment itself is already complete.

At exactly 18:00, he refreshes the page and the event upload area returns no-access status. Read, upload, and replacement access are all revoked together, leaving no undefined read-only remainder. Shao Yuan hands the memory card back to Lin Xi. The final upload record on his phone remains at 17:54.
storyParagraphsZh: 周五18:00，品牌活动刚开场，摄影师邵远已经拍满第一张相机卡。周末编辑都在现场，他需要自己把照片持续传进“秋季活动”上传区，也要能把自己刚传错的照片换掉。为了省审批，团队原本准备直接发整站内容管理员权限，但林溪决定先在测试环境把边界走一遍。
测试站点里有一套假目录和假图片。邵远以自己的测试身份完成正常流程：读取秋季活动上传区、上传新图、把自己名下的一张测试照片替换成新版本。随后林溪用同一个已认证身份、同一个预设请求去尝试删除上一级“往期活动”目录；服务端的权限预检在宽管理员角色下返回“允许删除”，但测试停在预检，没有删除假目录或正式资料。
团队随后给同一个测试身份换成窄角色：只能读取秋季活动上传区、上传新文件，并替换由该身份上传且仍属于该活动的文件；不能删除父目录、进入其他活动、管理用户或改产品页。再次用完全相同的越界删除请求做权限预检时，服务端返回拒绝。林溪把两次服务端预检结果与正常上传记录放在一起：同一身份、同一目录请求，结果从允许变成拒绝。
正常流程再跑一遍仍然成功，林溪才创建正式临时账号，权限与窄角色一致，有效期周五18:00至周日18:00，正好48小时。测试用管理员账号在正式账号启用前就已停用。若任务临时需要超出范围的动作，只能另走有期限的提升申请。
周六现场网速慢，邵远照样连续上传，也能替换自己名下的错误照片，没有每张都等编辑批准。周日17:54，他把最后一张活动图上传完成；17:57重新打开自己的文件还能正常检查，任务已经结束。
18:00一到，他刷新页面，活动上传区直接返回无访问权限，读取、上传和替换都一起撤回，没有留下只读尾巴。邵远把相机卡交给林溪，手机上最后一条上传记录停在17:54。
explanationParagraphs: The principle of least privilege gives a user or process only the minimum sufficient permissions for legitimate work. Authorization can be limited by resource and action, with an expiry for temporary work. Authentication or hiding buttons alone cannot replace authorization.

Here the production role allows reading, uploading, and replacing the photographer’s own event files from Friday 18:00 through Sunday 18:00, exactly 48 hours. The same out-of-scope request is rejected server-side under the narrow role.
explanationParagraphsZh: 最小权限要求用户或进程只获得完成合法任务所需的最低充分权限。授权可按资源和动作收窄，并按临时任务设定期限；身份认证或隐藏按钮本身不能替代授权。
本例正式角色只允许活动区读取、上传和替换本人文件，期限周五18:00至周日18:00共48小时。同一越界请求由服务端在窄角色下拒绝。
articles.overallZh: 这项虚构的周末摄影任务说明最小权限原则：用户或进程只获得完成合法工作所需的最低充分权限。活动区读取、上传和替换本人文件足以交付照片；临时任务另设48小时有效期。收窄无关能力，同时保留工作所需的完整路径。

moduleZh.intro: 先在安全测试环境用同一身份和同一越界请求比较授权范围，再把验证过的窄角色用于正式48小时任务。

articles.overall: This fictional weekend photography assignment illustrates the principle of least privilege: a user or process receives only the minimum sufficient access for legitimate work. Reading the event area, uploading, and replacing the photographer’s own files are enough to deliver the photographs. The temporary assignment also has a 48-hour expiry, narrowing unrelated capability while preserving the complete work path.

module.intro: Use the same identity and the same out-of-scope request in a safe test environment to compare authorization scope, then use the validated narrow role for the real 48-hour task.
module.diagramTitle: From Site-Wide Capability to “Event Area + Own Files + 48 Hours”
diagramSteps: The test identity first completes the legitimate upload/replacement flow under a broad administrator role
Under the same identity, the server authorizes the parent-directory deletion request in a precheck under the broad role
After switching to the narrow role, the identical request is explicitly rejected by the server
Once the legitimate workflow still succeeds, create the production account from Friday 18:00 to Sunday 18:00
Finish the final upload at 17:54 and revoke read/upload/replace access completely after 18:00

The comparison keeps identity and request constant and changes only the authorization role.
Replacement permission is constrained by both file ownership and event scope.
The production environment does not retain the temporary broad administrator account.
Access is fully revoked on expiry, avoiding an undefined residual read-only permission.
mapping: Memory card → the photographer’s real deliverable that must be completed within the authorization window.
Same prepared deletion request → the comparable check between broad and narrow authorization.

module.boundary: Least privilege must still support legitimate work; overly restrictive access can encourage workarounds or shared accounts. File ownership, server-side authorization, and expiration all require reliable implementation. The principle reduces available capability and impact scope but cannot eliminate every mistake, stolen credential, or system defect.

articles.title: Today’s Delivery Goes to River Road; the Old Receipt Still Says Pine Street
articles.titleZh: 今天送河路，旧签收单还写着松街
articles.summary: An equipment-rental shop needs to deliver a lighting rig to returning customer Zhou Yao. The old single table mixes the customer’s current contact information with the delivery address of each historical rental. Shen He checks the historical snapshot against the original signed receipt, then separates Customer and Rental facts and reconnects them with keys. Today’s order uses the current information, while the old order preserves its original address.
articles.summaryZh: 器材租赁店要给老客户周遥送一套灯架。旧单表把客户当前联系方式和每笔历史租单的送达地址混在同一组字段里；沈禾用原始签收凭证核对历史快照，再把Customer与Rental按不同事实拆开并通过键关联。今天订单取当前资料，旧订单保持原地址。
storyParagraphs: The equipment-rental shop is due to deliver a lighting rig to Zhou Yao that afternoon. In the morning she calls to say that her studio has moved from Pine Street to River Road and that her phone number has changed as well. Shen He opens the old system and sees Zhou Yao’s four previous rentals plus today’s fifth order, each repeating a name, phone number, and a field simply called “address.” Today’s R604 has not yet left the shop, and the driver is waiting for the latest delivery details.

Shen He first pulls out the signed receipt for R551 from three months earlier. The paper clearly says Pine Street and contains the original delivery acknowledgment, so the historical delivery address has an independent source; it does not need to be inferred backward from today’s River Road address. If all five rows were updated to River Road merely to make them consistent, the old transaction would be rewritten. But if only R604 were changed, the old table’s supposed “customer address” would contain multiple versions of a fact that is meant to be current.

They separate the two kinds of facts. In the Customer table, CustomerID C208 identifies Zhou Yao’s name, current phone number, and current contact address. In the Rental table, each RentalID identifies the rental period, amount, and the delivery-address snapshot stored when that particular order was confirmed. R604 records River Road when today’s delivery is confirmed, while R551 retains Pine Street from the original signed receipt.

After migration, Shen He updates C208’s current phone number and address only once in Customer. When R604 is opened, the system follows CustomerID to retrieve the current phone number while reading River Road from that order’s own delivery snapshot. When R551 is opened, the phone number is still the current new number, but the historical delivery address remains Pine Street. The two meanings are no longer forced into one ambiguous “address” field.

Before switching over, Shen He lays the four completed rentals beside their original documents, then joins the tables through CustomerID. Each order ID, amount, and delivery address matches. Each rental links to the single C208 customer record, with no missing rows or extra combinations. CustomerID remains unique, and Rental.CustomerID is a non-null foreign key that must refer to an existing customer. She saves these four checks with the migration record.

That afternoon, the driver takes R604 with the new phone number in the contact field and River Road in the delivery field. Shen He opens R551, where Pine Street still matches the original signed receipt. She closes the old order. The next change to Zhou Yao’s current contact details will still go into the C208 row in Customer.
storyParagraphsZh: 器材租赁店下午要给周遥送一套灯架。上午她来电话，说工作室已经从松街搬到河路，手机号也换了。沈禾打开旧系统，发现周遥过去四笔租单和今天待送的第五笔都重复着姓名、电话和一个叫“地址”的字段；今天这张R604还没出车，司机正等最新地址。
沈禾先翻出三个月前R551的签收凭证。那张纸清楚写着松街，并有当时的签收记录，所以历史送达地址有独立来源，不需要从今天的河路反推。若把五行地址全部更新为河路，旧交易会被改写；若只改R604，所谓“客户当前地址”又会在旧表里出现多个版本。
他们把两类事实拆开：Customer表中，CustomerID C208对应周遥的姓名、当前电话和当前联系地址；Rental表中，每个RentalID对应租期、金额以及那笔订单确认时保存的送达地址快照。R604在今天确认配送时写入河路，R551则把原始凭证中的松街保留下来。
迁移后，沈禾只在Customer里把C208的当前电话和地址更新一次。打开R604时，系统通过CustomerID取到新的联系电话，同时读取这笔订单自己的河路送达快照；打开R551时，联系电话仍是当前新号码，但历史送达地址仍是松街。同一“地址”不再承担两种语义。
切换前，沈禾把四笔已完成租单和原始单据并排放好，再按CustomerID执行连接查询。四个订单号、金额和各自的送达地址逐项对上，每笔租单只连接到C208的一条客户记录，没有丢行或多出组合。CustomerID保持唯一，Rental里的CustomerID也设为非空外键，必须指向现有客户；这四笔的核对结果随迁移记录一起保存。
下午司机拿走R604，联系栏是新号码，送达栏是河路。沈禾随后打开R551，松街仍和原签收凭证一致。她关掉旧单；下次要改周遥的当前联系资料，仍到Customer的C208那一行。
explanationParagraphs: Database normalization uses functional dependencies to place different facts in appropriate relations and reconnect them with keys, reducing update, insertion, and deletion anomalies caused by redundancy.

Here C208 determines current customer information, while R551 and R604 each determine their own transaction facts and delivery snapshots. Historical addresses come from original records; after decomposition, foreign-key constraints and correct join results still need to be preserved.
explanationParagraphsZh: 数据库规范化依据属性间函数依赖把不同事实放入合适关系，并用键重新连接，以减少冗余引起的更新、插入和删除异常。
本例C208决定当前客户资料，R551、R604各自决定交易事实和送达快照。历史地址来自原始凭证；拆分后还需保持外键等约束并验证连接结果。

articles.overallZh: 本篇用虚构租赁数据说明数据库规范化：依据函数依赖和事实语义拆分关系，再通过键重新关联，以减少同一事实重复维护造成的更新、插入和删除异常。当前客户资料与历史订单快照属于不同事实，拆分后仍需验证无损连接和必要约束。

moduleZh.intro: 先用原始凭证区分“客户现在在哪里”和“某笔订单当时送到哪里”，再按函数依赖拆分并重新关联。
moduleZh.diagramTitle: 当前地址只改一处，历史订单为什么仍保留旧门牌
diagramSteps: 识别旧单表把当前客户资料重复写进多笔租单
用原始R551签收凭证确认历史送达地址独立于当前地址
把Customer当前资料与Rental交易快照拆开，并用CustomerID关联
更新C208一次，同时让R551保留松街、R604保存河路
用原始单据、连接查询和外键检查本次迁移结果
diagramStepNotes: 问题不是所有重复都错误，而是同一当前事实被多处独立维护。
历史快照必须来自当时记录，不能由现在的地址推算。
旧表有RentalID→CustomerID→当前客户资料的传递依赖；订单自己的历史送达快照仍由RentalID决定。
当前资料变化不应重写已经完成的交易快照。
四笔核对只验证这个教学迁移实例，不等于一般无损连接证明。
mapping: C208 → 当前客户属性的识别键。
R551签收凭证 → 松街历史快照的独立证据来源。
R604 → 今天待送且保存河路快照的订单。
外键 → 防止租单关联到不存在客户的关系约束。
moduleZh.boundary: 规范化不要求消除所有重复，也不意味着表越多越好。历史快照、审计数据和受控冗余可能有独立业务意义；拆分后必须保持无损连接和必要约束。Codd 1970论文奠定关系模型并讨论当时的normal form，不应被说成已经包含后来全部2NF、3NF等理论。本例CustomerID在客户表唯一，租单的CustomerID是非空外键，每笔租单因而连接到一条现有客户记录；四笔实测核对仍不能替代一般设计的无损连接分析。
moduleZh.reflection: 为什么周遥搬家后，Customer里的当前地址应该改成河路，而R551里的松街却必须继续保留？

referencesZh.citation: Codd, E. F. (1970). A Relational Model of Data for Large Shared Data Banks. Communications of the ACM, 13(6), 377–387.
referencesZh.use: 支持关系模型、键、冗余与当时normal form等基础思想；不把后来全部规范化理论都归为该论文已完整提出。

referencesZh.citation: Microsoft. Database design basics.
referencesZh.use: 提供实体、键、关系和常见规范化实践说明，用于理解如何减少更新异常并维持数据关系。

articles.overall: Database normalization is illustrated here through fictional rental data: relations are decomposed according to functional dependencies and the meaning of facts, then reconnected through keys to reduce update, insertion, and deletion anomalies caused by maintaining the same fact in multiple places. Current customer data and historical order snapshots are different facts, and decomposition still requires lossless relationships and necessary constraints to be preserved.

module.intro: Use the original receipt to separate “where the customer is now” from “where this order was delivered then,” then decompose the data according to functional dependencies and reconnect it.
module.diagramTitle: Why the Current Address Changes Once While the Historical Order Keeps Its Old Street
diagramSteps: Identify that the old single table repeats current customer information across multiple rentals
Use the original R551 signed receipt to confirm that the historical delivery address is independent of the current address
Separate current Customer facts from Rental transaction snapshots and reconnect them through CustomerID
Update C208 once while R551 retains Pine Street and R604 stores River Road
Check the migration against original documents, join queries, and foreign-key constraints
diagramStepNotes: The problem is not that all repetition is wrong; it is that one current fact is independently maintained in multiple places.
A historical snapshot must come from a record made at the time, not be reconstructed from the current address.
The old table has the transitive dependency RentalID→CustomerID→current customer attributes; the historical delivery snapshot still depends on its own RentalID.
A change in current customer information should not rewrite completed transaction snapshots.
Checking four records validates this teaching migration instance only; it is not a general proof of lossless decomposition.
mapping: C208 → the identifying key for current customer attributes.
R551 signed receipt → independent evidence for the Pine Street historical snapshot.
R604 → today’s order storing the River Road snapshot.
Foreign key → a relational constraint preventing a rental from referencing a nonexistent customer.
module.boundary: Normalization does not require eliminating every repetition, nor does more tables automatically mean better design. Historical snapshots, audit records, and controlled redundancy can have independent business value; decomposition must preserve lossless joins and necessary constraints. Codd’s 1970 paper established the relational model and discussed the normal form of that period; it should not be described as already containing the complete later theory of 2NF, 3NF, and all subsequent normal forms. In this example, CustomerID is unique in Customer and is a non-null foreign key in Rental, so each rental joins to one existing customer record. Checking four records still does not replace lossless-join analysis for a general design.
module.reflection: Why should Zhou Yao’s current address in Customer change to River Road, while Pine Street in R551 must remain unchanged?

references.citation: Codd, E. F. (1970). A Relational Model of Data for Large Shared Data Banks. Communications of the ACM, 13(6), 377–387.

articles.title: After the Page Times Out, Mei Checks the Booking Result
articles.titleZh: 页面超时以后，梅先查预约结果
articles.summary: A fixed five-node, non-Byzantine booking service experiences a network partition. The term-8 leader persistently writes Mei’s 14:00 request to only A and B before losing contact. In term 9, new leader C commits another 14:00 booking command on a majority and applies it before returning success. Later, D wins term 10 with three votes because of its more up-to-date log; even after old-term entry 42 is replicated to a majority, it is not committed merely by counting copies, but becomes part of the committed prefix after current-term entry 43 is replicated to a majority.
articles.summaryZh: 固定五节点、非拜占庭的预约服务发生网络分裂。任期8领导只把梅的14:00请求持久写到A、B两台便失联；任期9新领导C在多数节点提交另一条14:00预约命令并应用后才返回成功。后续D在任期10凭较新日志获三票，当旧任期42复制到多数时仍不直接提交，而由当前任期43多数提交后带动前缀提交。
storyParagraphs: Only one 14:00 slot remains at the shared photo studio. The booking service consists of a fixed set of five non-Byzantine nodes, A, B, C, D, and E, all replicating the same log. Mei submits a booking from her phone and the page keeps spinning. Term-8 leader A has already persistently written Reserve(梅,14:00) at log position 41 on itself and B, but before a third copy is persisted, A and B lose contact with C, D, and E. Mei sees only a timeout and does not click again.

C, D, and E remain connected, enter term 9, and elect C as leader; all three had previously committed only through position 40. C then receives Ren’s 14:00 request, writes Reserve(任,14:00) at position 41, and persistently replicates it to C, D, and E. After reaching 3/5, C advances the commit index and applies position 41 to the booking state machine in log order. The state machine checks that 14:00 is still free, records the slot for Ren, and only then does the service return success to Ren.

Mei uses the “Check booking” action shown on the timeout page to look up the final result. When communication recovers, A sees the higher term and steps down to follower. As the current leader sends its log, A and B discover a term conflict at position 41; the uncommitted term-8 entry is removed and replaced by the leader’s term-9 position 41. The query goes to term-9 leader C. After confirming its leadership with a majority and reading the state with entry 41 applied, C reports that Mei has no valid 14:00 booking. Her timeout is treated as neither proof of success nor proof of failure.

Later, C writes SetEquipment(16:00房间,投影仪) at position 42 in term 9 and persists it only to C and D before crashing, so entry 42 is still uncommitted. D has the last log entry (term 9, position 42) and starts a term-10 election. A and E have both caught up through last entry (term 9, position 41). Because the last-log terms are equal and D’s index is larger, they each vote for D; together with D’s own vote, D wins 3/5 and becomes leader.

As term-10 leader, D replicates old term-9 entry 42 to A, D, and E. Even though entry 42 now has copies on a majority, D does not advance its committed status merely from that count. In this teaching implementation, D next appends LeaderNoOp at position 43 in current term 10 and persistently replicates it to D, A, and E. Once current-term entry 43 reaches a majority, the commit index advances to 43, and the continuous prefix including entry 42 becomes committed as well.

After C restarts, D sends it the committed prefix as well, and the five nodes gradually align on the operations screen. The customer page shows Mei’s query result and Ren’s confirmed 14:00 booking, without term numbers. The operations log gives positions 41, 42, and 43 their own rows, recording replication and commitment separately. The timeout remains on the investigation list.
storyParagraphsZh: 共享摄影棚的14:00档只剩一个。预约服务固定由A、B、C、D、E五台非拜占庭节点复制同一日志。梅在手机上提交预约后页面一直转圈：任期8领导A已经把“Reserve(梅,14:00)”持久写到自己和B的日志位置41，但第三份还没落盘，A、B就与C、D、E失联。梅只看到超时，没有再点一次。
C、D、E仍互通，进入任期9并选C为领导；它们此前都只提交到位置40。C随后收到任的14:00预约，把“Reserve(任,14:00)”写在位置41并持久复制到C、D、E。达到3/5后，C推进提交位置并按顺序把41应用到预约状态机；状态机检查14:00仍为空，才把档期记给任，随后服务向任返回成功。
梅按超时页面上的“查询预约”查看最终结果。网络恢复后，A看到更高任期便退回跟随者；新领导发送日志时，A、B在位置41发现任期冲突，未提交的任期8条目被删除并改成领导的任期9位置41。查询交给任期9的C：它先通过多数节点确认自己仍是领导，再读取已经应用位置41的状态，返回梅没有有效14:00预约。她的超时既没有被当作成功凭证，也没有被直接当作失败凭证。
稍后C在任期9把位置42写成“SetEquipment(16:00房间,投影仪)”，只持久到C、D两台便宕机，所以42尚未提交。D拥有最后日志(任期9,位置42)，它发起任期10选举。A和E都已追到最后日志(任期9,位置41)；比较最后日志任期相同而D索引更大后，它们各投一票，加上D自己一票，D以3/5当选。
D成为任期10领导后，把旧任期9的位置42复制到A、D、E三台。即使42此时已有多数副本，D也没有仅凭这个计数直接推进它的提交状态。这个教学实现随后在位置43追加任期10的LeaderNoOp，并持久复制到D、A、E；当前任期43达到多数后，提交位置推进到43，连续前缀中的42也随之成为已提交。
C重启后，D也把已提交前缀同步给它；值班屏幕上的五台节点逐步对齐。顾客页面只显示梅的查询结果和任的14:00预约确认，不展示任期号。运维日志里，41、42、43各占一行，复制和提交状态分别记录；那次超时仍留在待查列表上。
explanationParagraphs: Distributed consensus requires replicated nodes to agree on committed commands and their order even when delays or failures occur. Raft maintains this property through leader terms, log matching, election restrictions, and majority replication.

With five nodes, a current-term entry must be persistently replicated to at least three nodes before the leader can advance commitment under this rule. Old term-9 entry 42 cannot be committed merely because it later has majority copies; committing current-term entry 43 can carry the continuous prefix forward.
explanationParagraphsZh: 分布式共识要求复制节点即使发生延迟或故障，也对已提交命令及顺序保持一致。Raft用领导任期、日志匹配、选举限制和多数复制维护这一性质。
五节点中，本任期条目持久复制到至少3节点后才可按规则推进提交。旧任期42即使后来已有多数副本，也不能仅据此直接提交；当前任期43多数提交后可带动连续前缀。

articles.overallZh: 本篇用虚构固定五节点、非拜占庭Raft式例子说明分布式共识：复制节点在延迟、失联和崩溃下仍需保持同一已提交命令及顺序。领导任期、日志匹配、选举限制和多数复制共同维护安全性；业务上的唯一预约还需由确定性的应用状态机按统一顺序检查空位。

moduleZh.intro: 把顾客看到的成功/超时与运维内部的写入、复制、提交、应用分开，沿两个任期切换检查Raft规则。

diagramSteps: 任期8领导A把梅的位置41写到A/B两台后分裂，用户只收到超时
任期9领导C把任的位置41复制到C/D/E，提交并应用后才返回成功

D凭最后日志(9,42)在任期10获得D/A/E三票当选
D先复制旧任期42，再多数复制当前任期43，使提交位置推进并带动42
diagramStepNotes: 2/5不是多数，少数分区不能确认新的已提交命令。

日志冲突修正服从当前领导，只覆盖冲突的未提交后缀。

LeaderNoOp是本教学实现用来产生当前任期条目的选择，不宣称是唯一必须实现方式。

14:00唯一档期 → 由应用状态机按统一命令顺序检查的业务约束。

moduleZh.boundary: 这是固定五节点、非拜占庭的简化Raft教学情境，不覆盖恶意节点或完整实现。多数交集本身不足以推出全部安全性，还依赖任期、日志匹配和选举限制；共识只统一已提交命令顺序，不自动提供业务去重或唯一性。失去多数时系统可能停止推进，因此安全性也不等于永久可用。只读查询也需确认当前领导和已应用提交状态，不能任取失联节点上的旧读数。

articles.overall: Distributed consensus is illustrated here with a fictional fixed five-node, non-Byzantine Raft-style example: replicated nodes must preserve the same committed commands and order despite delays, disconnections, and crashes. Leader terms, log matching, election restrictions, and majority replication work together to preserve safety; the business rule that only one booking may occupy a slot is still enforced by the deterministic application state machine executing the agreed command order.

module.intro: Separate customer-visible success and timeout from the internal states of writing, replication, commitment, and application, then trace the rules across two term changes.
module.diagramTitle: How Positions 41, 42, and 43 Move Through Uncommitted, Current-Term Commit, and Prefix Advancement
diagramSteps: Term-8 leader A writes Mei’s position 41 to A/B and partitions; the user receives only a timeout
Term-9 leader C replicates Ren’s position 41 to C/D/E, commits and applies it, then returns success
After communication recovers, the leader’s log overwrites the conflicting uncommitted term-8 position 41 on A/B
With last log (9,42), D wins term 10 with votes from D/A/E
D first replicates old-term entry 42, then majority-replicates current-term entry 43 so the commit index advances and carries 42 with the prefix
diagramStepNotes: 2/5 is not a majority, so the minority partition cannot confirm a new committed command.
The application executes Reserve in committed-log order and independently checks whether the 14:00 slot is available.
Log conflict repair follows the current leader and overwrites only the conflicting uncommitted suffix.
Election log freshness compares the last-log term first and, when terms are equal, the index.
LeaderNoOp is the choice used in this teaching implementation to create a current-term entry; it is not claimed to be the only required implementation form.
mapping: Mei’s timeout page → whether the client received a response is different from whether the command committed.
The unique 14:00 slot → a business constraint enforced by the application state machine over a shared command order.
Position 42 equipment setting → a concrete old-term uncommitted command that does not compete again for the 14:00 booking.
Position 43 LeaderNoOp → a current-term entry whose majority commitment advances the continuous committed prefix.
module.boundary: This is a simplified fixed five-node, non-Byzantine Raft teaching scenario and does not cover malicious nodes or every implementation detail. Majority intersection alone is not sufficient to establish all safety properties; terms, log matching, and election restrictions also matter. Consensus orders committed commands but does not automatically provide business-level deduplication or uniqueness. If a majority is unavailable, progress may stop, so safety does not imply permanent availability. Read-only queries also need current-leader confirmation and applied committed state; an arbitrary disconnected node may return stale data.
module.reflection: Why does Ren receive success only after position 41 is committed and applied, while D still cannot call old-term entry 42 committed merely because it later has copies on three nodes?

references.citation: Ongaro, D., & Ousterhout, J. (2014). In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm (Extended Version). Technical report, May 20, 2014.
references.use: Supports Raft terms, log matching, election restrictions, current-term commitment and advancement of earlier prefixes; section 8 also explains precautions against stale read-only results.

references.citation: Raft project. The Raft Consensus Algorithm.
references.use: Provides a project-level overview of Raft replicated state machines and consistent logs, supporting the goal that nodes preserve the same committed commands and order.

articles.title: Three Order IDs on the Recovery List
articles.titleZh: 恢复名单上的三个订单号
articles.summary: In an isolated exercise environment, a delivery platform assumes that one customer-service session is already compromised. Network segmentation blocks the finance and backup networks, while the application role limits actions to a dedicated test queue. Three permitted test orders are still changed. Audit logs let monitoring identify that affected set, and recovery restores only those three while preserving the valid address B on the separate normal exercise order N-17.
articles.summaryZh: 配送平台在隔离演练环境中预设一个客服会话已失守。网络分区阻断财务和备份网络，应用角色限制到指定测试队列；队列内仍有三笔测试订单被改，审计日志让监测锁定订单集合，恢复人员只还原这三笔，另一个正常演练订单保留有效修改。
storyParagraphs: A delivery platform is preparing a nighttime recovery exercise and does not want real evening-shift orders drawn into the test. The team builds an isolated exercise environment from a sanitized snapshot. It contains a dedicated test queue T and one order, N-17, representing normal customer-service work. Su Wei directly marks a red test session as “identity compromised,” while an operator uses a normal exercise account to change N-17’s address from A to B.

The red session follows the customer-service access path into the order area. It can reach the order service, but network segmentation blocks the finance and backup segments. Inside the application, it can open dedicated queue T; its application role refuses operations on the normal exercise queue containing N-17. That order still shows the newly entered address B, and the operator’s normal exercise account remains active. Su Wei lets the script continue.

The exercise script has the red session make a series of address changes within queue T, where it still has permission. Changes to T-31, T-32, and T-33 are actually written into the exercise order database, while a fourth out-of-scope object is rejected by the application role. For every write, the audit service records the session ID, order ID, and change time. A few minutes later, monitoring detects the burst of changes from the same session and raises an alert, so Su Wei suspends that session.

The incident sheet cites the three order IDs directly from the audit log instead of relying on memory. Before the exercise began, the recovery service had saved a snapshot of the test order database. Recovery staff retrieve the pre-exercise states of T-31 through T-33 from the snapshot and apply them only to those three IDs. N-17 was changed by a different normal session, is not part of the red-session log set, and never enters the recovery list, so its valid A→B change remains.

After recovery, the operator reopens all four orders. T-31, T-32, and T-33 are back at their pre-exercise addresses, while N-17 still shows B. The review then identifies another risk: if segmentation policy, monitoring configuration, and recovery credentials are all controlled through the same super-administrator identity, several layers could be affected together. The team separates recovery credentials from the daily management identity, but treats that only as reducing one common dependency; other shared infrastructure remains on the checklist for the next exercise.

At the end of the exercise, five cards remain on the board: Identity, Segmentation, Role, Monitoring, Backup. The red Identity card stays flipped over. Beside it, the incident sheet circles only T-31, T-32, and T-33. N-17’s address B remains written at the bottom and has not been erased by recovery.
storyParagraphsZh: 配送平台准备做夜间恢复演练，又不想把真实晚班订单卷进测试。团队用脱敏快照搭了隔离演练环境，里面有专用测试队列T和一笔代表正常客服工作的订单N-17。苏蔚把一条红色测试会话直接标成“身份已失守”，值班员则用正常演练账号把N-17的地址从A改成B。
红色会话沿客服访问路径进入订单区，订单服务仍可到达，财务网段和备份网段却被网络分区阻断。进入订单应用后，它能打开专用队列T，尝试操作N-17所在的正常演练队列时，应用角色返回拒绝。N-17仍显示刚改好的B地址，值班员的正常演练账号没有被一起停掉，苏蔚让脚本继续往下跑。
演练脚本让红色会话在自己仍被允许的T队列内连续改地址。T-31、T-32、T-33三笔修改真实写入演练订单库，第四个越界对象则被角色拒绝。每次写入都会由审计服务记录会话ID、订单ID和变更时间；几分钟后，监测因同一会话短时连续修改触发告警，苏蔚暂停该会话。
处置单直接引用审计日志里的三个订单ID，而不是靠人回忆。演练开始前，恢复服务已经为测试订单库保存快照；恢复人员从快照取回T-31至T-33的演练前状态，再逐笔应用到这三个ID。N-17由另一个正常会话修改，既不在红色会话日志集合里，也没有进入恢复清单，所以它的A→B有效修改被保留下来。
恢复后，值班员重新打开四笔订单：T-31、T-32、T-33回到演练前地址，N-17仍是B。复盘又发现，若分区策略、监测配置和恢复凭证都受同一超级管理员控制，几层可能一起受影响。团队把恢复凭证与日常管理身份分开，但只把这视为减少一个共同依赖，其他共享基础设施仍列在下一次检查单上。
演练结束，白板上排着五张卡：身份、分区、角色、监测、备份。红色身份卡依旧翻面，旁边处置单只圈着T-31、T-32、T-33；N-17的B地址写在最下面，没有被恢复动作擦掉。
explanationParagraphs: Defense in depth combines people, technical, and operational controls with different roles so that after one layer fails, other layers may still limit reachable scope, detect abnormal activity, or restore affected state.

Here network segmentation limits network paths, the application role limits order objects, monitoring uses audit logs to detect the anomaly, and backup restores only T-31 through T-33. Shared-administrator risk is reduced but not eliminated.
explanationParagraphsZh: 纵深防御通过不同作用的人员、技术和运营控制相互补充，使单层失效后，其他层仍可能限制可达范围、发现异常或恢复受损状态。
本例网络分区限制网络路径，应用角色限制订单对象，监测依审计日志发现异常，备份只恢复T-31至T-33。共同管理员风险仍未被完全消除。
articles.overallZh: 这场虚构的隔离演练说明纵深防御：不同控制分别限制可达路径、限制操作对象、发现残余异常和恢复受损状态。T队列被改过，但N-17的正常修改仍保留；控制有共同依赖时仍可能同时失效，多层并不自动带来独立性或零风险。

moduleZh.boundary: 这是隔离环境中的高层次演练，不提供攻击操作。监测依赖日志完整性，恢复依赖快照覆盖和恢复过程正确；分区、角色、日志、备份也可能共享基础设施或管理身份。多层控制只能降低某些单点失效影响，不能推出独立概率相乘或零风险。本例受影响的T记录没有其他正常修改；若同一记录交错发生合法改动，不能只按会话圈出ID后直接回退旧快照，还需保留或协调这些改动。
moduleZh.reflection: 为什么T-31至T-33已经被真实修改并不说明前面的限制毫无价值，而N-17没有被恢复又说明恢复层必须知道影响集合？

referencesZh.citation: NIST Computer Security Resource Center. Defense-in-depth, Glossary.
referencesZh.use: 提供由人员、技术与运营构成多层防护的权威定义，强调多种屏障共同降低单层失效影响，但不意味着零风险。

referencesZh.citation: Mell, P., Shook, J., & Harang, R. Measuring and Improving the Effectiveness of Defense-in-Depth Postures.
referencesZh.use: 支持评估不同防线的独立性、相互关系与共同漏洞，提醒多层架构不能简单假定失效概率彼此独立。

articles.overall: This fictional isolated exercise illustrates defense in depth: different controls constrain reachable paths, restrict order objects, detect residual abnormal activity, and restore affected state. Queue T was changed, but N-17’s legitimate change remains. Shared dependencies can still cause correlated failures; multiple layers do not automatically imply independence or zero risk.

module.intro: Make one layer fail explicitly in an isolated exercise, then use actual writes, logs, and selective recovery to check what each later layer really changes.
module.diagramTitle: After the Identity Layer Fails, Why Do Three Abnormal Changes Not Become a Whole-Database Restore?
diagramSteps: Build an isolated exercise environment from a sanitized snapshot and assume the red customer-service session is compromised
Use network segmentation to block finance/backup paths and an application role to restrict actions to test queue T
Allow T-31 through T-33 to be changed while audit logs record the session and order IDs
After monitoring alerts, suspend the session and selectively restore the three logged orders from the snapshot
Verify that N-17’s normal change remains and review shared super-administrator dependencies across layers
diagramStepNotes: Real production evening-shift orders are not part of the simulated attack path.
Network controls and application roles restrict different dimensions and are not substitutes for one another.
Residual permitted actions cause real but limited changes; the exercise does not assume later layers block everything.
The recovery set is determined from audit logs, preventing an independent normal exercise order from being overwritten.
Separating recovery credentials reduces one common failure point but does not prove that all other layers are independent.
mapping: Red test session → the identity layer explicitly assumed to have failed.
Test queue T and N-17 → a clear separation between the abnormal set and a normal business example.
Order IDs in the audit log → the basis for defining the affected recovery set after the alert.
Five cards → the five functional positions of identity, segmentation, role, monitoring, and backup.
module.boundary: This is a high-level exercise in an isolated environment and does not provide attack instructions. Monitoring depends on log completeness, while recovery depends on snapshot coverage and correct restoration. Segmentation, roles, logs, and backup may still share infrastructure or management identities. Multiple controls can reduce the impact of some single-layer failures but do not justify multiplying independent failure probabilities or claiming zero risk. In this example, the affected T records have no other legitimate updates. When legitimate writes overlap on the same record, identifying IDs by session is not enough to justify reverting old snapshots; those updates need preservation or reconciliation.
module.reflection: Why do the real changes to T-31 through T-33 not show that the earlier restrictions were useless, and why does preserving N-17 show that the recovery layer must know the affected set?

references.citation: NIST Computer Security Resource Center. Defense-in-depth, Glossary.
references.use: Provides an authoritative definition of layered protection using people, technology, and operations, emphasizing that multiple barriers can reduce the impact of a single-layer failure without implying zero risk.

references.citation: Mell, P., Shook, J., & Harang, R. Measuring and Improving the Effectiveness of Defense-in-Depth Postures.
references.use: Supports evaluating independence, relationships, and common vulnerabilities across defensive layers, cautioning against simply assuming that layer failures are probabilistically independent.

articles.title: Where Did the Blue Dictionary’s Cover Go?
articles.titleZh: 蓝字典的封面去了哪里
articles.summary: A secondhand-book platform initially lets the product page, chat preview, and export tool use storage-provider URLs directly. When the provider changes its link rules, all three callers for the blue dictionary must be changed. The team then stores mediaId consistently and obtains a currently usable URL through get(mediaId). During the second migration, only the media component needs to change because the mediaId mapping, object content, access semantics, and interface contract remain unchanged.
articles.summaryZh: 二手书平台最初让商品页、聊天预览和导出工具直接使用供应商URL。供应商改变链接规则时，蓝字典的三个调用方都要修改；团队随后统一存mediaId，并通过get(mediaId)获取当前可用URL。第二次迁移在mediaId映射、对象内容、访问语义和接口契约保持不变时，只需改媒体组件内部。
storyParagraphs: On Monday morning, a seller urgently wants the cover of an old blue dictionary restored. The product page shows a broken image, the buyer’s chat preview is blank, and a new product export due at noon cannot obtain a usable image address. All three places directly store or construct URLs from the same storage provider, which has just stopped supporting the old URL format.

Zhou Kai first restores the immediate delivery. He changes the product page, chat preview, and export tool to use the provider’s new URL rule. He opens the blue dictionary’s cover from the product page and checks the chat thumbnail and the address in the newly generated export. Its three paths work again, with changes in three places: one provider rule has entered the image-display, chat-preview, and export code.

He then defines a new boundary. After an image is stored, the media component returns a stable mediaId, and business data stores only that ID. When the product page or chat needs to display the image, it calls get(mediaId) for a currently usable URL. A newly generated export also calls that same interface at generation time for the URL usable then. Bucket names, object locations, and signing rules remain inside the component, but a returned URL may expire; the design does not promise that URLs embedded in old export files remain usable forever.

The first move to this boundary still requires each of the three callers to change once. They stop depending directly on provider URLs, store mediaId instead, and request a current URL when needed. Zhou Kai reuploads the blue dictionary cover and checks the product page, chat, and a newly generated export one by one. The new interface preserves the required read-access semantics and the image content itself. The adaptation, interface tests, and error handling are all recorded as part of the refactoring cost.

Two months later, the team moves the image objects to another storage region. The migration preserves the mapping from every mediaId to the same image object, while access semantics and the get(mediaId)→url contract also remain unchanged. Zhou Kai modifies only the media component’s location and URL-generation implementation. The three caller codebases do not change, and newly generated URLs now point to the new region.

After release, the seller opens the blue dictionary product page again. The chat thumbnail works, and a newly generated export also receives a currently usable image URL. Zhou Kai removes the three old provider-rule notes from the board and leaves only two lines: store(file)→mediaId and get(mediaId)→url.
storyParagraphsZh: 周一早上，一名卖家催着恢复一本蓝色旧字典的封面：商品页裂图，买家聊天里的缩略图也空了，中午要生成的新商品导出同样拿不到可用图片地址。三处都直接保存或拼接同一家存储供应商的旧URL，而供应商刚停止旧格式。
周恺先救当前交付。他分别修改商品页、聊天预览和导出工具，让它们适配新供应商URL规则；再从蓝字典的商品页打开封面，核对聊天里的缩略图和当次新导出的地址。这本书的三条路径接通了，他手里的改动也分落在三处。供应商的一条新规则，分别进了显示图片、聊天预览和导出清单的代码。
随后他定义新的边界：上传图片后媒体组件返回稳定的mediaId，业务数据只保存这个ID；商品页和聊天在需要显示时调用get(mediaId)取得“当前可用URL”。新生成的导出文件也在生成时调用同一接口取得当时可用URL。桶名、对象位置和签名生成方式留在组件内部，但URL可能有有效期，并不承诺旧导出文件中的地址永久可用。
第一次接入这个边界仍要改三个调用方一次：它们从直接依赖供应商URL改为保存mediaId、需要时请求当前URL。周恺用蓝字典逐一重跑商品页、聊天和新导出；新接口保持原本需要的读取权限语义，图片内容也不变。额外的适配、接口测试和错误处理都记进了这次重构成本。
两个月后，团队把图片对象迁到另一个存储区域。迁移脚本保留每个mediaId与同一图片对象的映射，访问权限语义和get(mediaId)→url契约也保持不变。周恺只改媒体组件里的位置和取址实现，三个调用方代码没有跟着改；新生成的URL指向新区域。
发布后，卖家再次打开蓝字典商品页，聊天缩略图正常，新导出的清单也拿到了当前可用图片URL。周恺把三张旧供应商规则便签撕掉，白板上只留两行：store(file)→mediaId，get(mediaId)→url。
explanationParagraphs: Modularity encapsulates related responsibilities behind boundaries so other parts use them through defined interfaces; information hiding specifically keeps likely-to-change design decisions inside the module, reducing change propagation.

The first move to the mediaId interface still changes three callers. When a later migration preserves ID mapping, content, access, and the get→url contract, code changes stay inside the media component. Moving objects and checking mappings still require work.
explanationParagraphsZh: 模块化把相关职责封装在边界内，其他部分通过明确接口使用功能；信息隐藏强调把可能变化的设计决策留在模块内部，以减少修改传播。
本例初次接入mediaId接口仍改三个调用方；后次迁移保留ID映射、内容、权限和get→url契约，代码改动才限于媒体组件。对象搬迁和映射核对仍须执行。
articles.overallZh: 这本蓝字典的虚构迁移经历说明模块化：职责边界和稳定接口可以减少内部变化向调用方传播。稳定的是mediaId与接口契约，返回URL仍可能变化或过期。初次改造、后续数据迁移与核对都有成本；模块化也不自动隔离运行故障。

moduleZh.intro: 用同一本蓝字典追踪两次迁移：第一次建立边界需要外部改造，第二次在契约不变时观察变化是否被留在内部。
moduleZh.diagramTitle: 从供应商URL散落三处，到mediaId稳定跨越第二次迁移
diagramSteps: 三处调用方直接依赖旧供应商URL，第一次规则变化需分别修改
定义store(file)→mediaId和get(mediaId)→当前可用url
三个调用方一次性改为保存mediaId并按需取URL
第二次迁移保持mediaId映射、图片内容、访问语义和接口契约
只修改媒体组件内部位置/取址实现并重跑蓝字典三条路径
diagramStepNotes: 第一次修复只核对蓝字典相关路径，不宣称全站对象均恢复。
返回URL可有有效期，稳定承诺落在mediaId与接口语义上。
旧导出文件里的URL不会因模块化自动刷新。
内部迁移只有在外部契约不变时才无需修改调用方。
模块边界降低变化传播，不等于运行时故障自动隔离。
mapping: 蓝字典封面 → 两次迁移都可核对的同一业务对象。
三张旧URL规则便签 → 易变供应商细节泄漏到调用方。
mediaId → 跨内部位置变化保持的业务标识。
当前可用URL → 由媒体组件按需返回、但不承诺永久有效的结果。
moduleZh.boundary: 模块化降低适当边界内的变化传播，不保证旧导出链接永久有效，也不自动隔离故障、增加容量或消除复杂度。若mediaId语义、访问权限、对象内容或接口输入输出发生变化，调用方仍可能需要协调修改。减少的是调用方代码变动，数据迁移、部署与一致性核对仍有成本。
moduleZh.reflection: 为什么第二次迁移能只改媒体组件，关键不在“有了模块”四个字，而在于哪些对外约定实际保持了不变？

referencesZh.citation: Parnas, D. L. (1972). On the criteria to be used in decomposing systems into modules. Communications of the ACM, 15(12), 1053–1058.
referencesZh.use: 作为信息隐藏与模块分解的经典来源，支持围绕可能变化的设计决策建立模块边界，而不是仅按处理步骤或文件大小拆分。

referencesZh.citation: IEEE Computer Society. Why Software Design Is Important.
referencesZh.use: 提供现代软件设计中模块化与关注点分离的应用概述，支持通过清晰结构降低变化和维护复杂度。

articles.overall: The blue dictionary’s fictional migration illustrates modularity: responsibility boundaries and stable interfaces can reduce propagation of internal changes to callers. The stable commitment is the mediaId and interface contract; returned URLs may change or expire. Initial refactoring, later data migration, and verification still have costs, and modularity does not automatically isolate runtime failures.

module.intro: Use the same blue dictionary across two migrations: the first establishes the boundary and requires external adaptation; the second checks whether change stays internal when the contract remains stable.
module.diagramTitle: From Provider URLs in Three Places to a mediaId That Survives the Second Migration
diagramSteps: Three callers directly depend on the old provider URL rule, so the first rule change requires three separate modifications
Define store(file)→mediaId and get(mediaId)→currently usable url
Change all three callers once so they store mediaId and request URLs when needed
During the second migration, preserve mediaId mapping, image content, access semantics, and the interface contract
Modify only media-component location/URL logic and rerun the blue-dictionary paths
diagramStepNotes: The first repair checks only the blue dictionary paths and does not claim every object on the site has been restored.
Returned URLs may expire; the stable commitment is placed on mediaId and interface semantics.
URLs embedded in old export files are not automatically refreshed by modularity.
The later migration avoids caller changes only because the external contract remains unchanged.
A module boundary reduces change propagation; it does not automatically isolate runtime failures.
mapping: Blue dictionary cover → the same business object checked across both migrations.
Three old URL-rule notes → volatile provider details leaking into multiple callers.
mediaId → the business identifier retained across internal location changes.
Currently usable URL → a value returned on demand by the media component, without a promise of permanent validity.
module.boundary: Modularity reduces propagation of changes that fit behind an appropriate boundary. It does not guarantee that old export links remain valid forever, automatically isolate failures, increase capacity, or remove complexity. If mediaId semantics, access permissions, object content, or interface inputs and outputs change, callers may still require coordinated modifications. What decreases is caller code change; data migration, deployment, and consistency checks still have costs.
module.reflection: Why can the second migration change only the media component not merely because “there is a module,” but because specific external commitments actually remain unchanged?

references.citation: Parnas, D. L. (1972). On the criteria to be used in decomposing systems into modules. Communications of the ACM, 15(12), 1053–1058.
references.use: Serves as a classic source for information hiding and modular decomposition, supporting boundaries organized around design decisions likely to change rather than simply around processing steps or file size.

references.citation: IEEE Computer Society. Why Software Design Is Important.
references.use: Provides a modern applied overview of modularity and separation of concerns in software design, supporting the use of clear structure to reduce change propagation and maintenance complexity.

articles.title: The Discount Stays Closed Until the Total Reaches €21.60
articles.summary: Before a coffee shop releases a 10%-off promotion, three €8 drinks should total €21.60 under a test rule with no tax, delivery charge, or other fee, but the page repeatedly shows €23.20. An Lan keeps two failed orders. Only afterward does the developer debug the implementation and locate a one-item-only discount. Once fixed, the original case passes, then the team checks the two-item boundary and previously correct one-item and no-discount paths.
articles.summaryZh: 咖啡店上线九折优惠前，3杯×€8在无税、运费或其他附加费的测试规则下应为€21.60，页面却两次稳定显示€23.20。安澜保留两张失败订单，开发者随后调试出“只给一杯打折”的实现问题；修复后原用例确认通过，再检查同类边界与原本正确路径。
storyParagraphs: The coffee shop plans to open a 10%-off preorder promotion on Saturday morning. Before closing on Friday, An Lan starts with an empty cart under a reusable test promotion code and adds three identical drinks at €8 each. The test rule explicitly excludes tax, delivery, and any other fee, and the discount applies to the entire line subtotal. €24.00 should therefore receive a €2.40 discount and produce a total of €21.60, but the checkout page shows €23.20.

The owner keeps the promotion entry closed. An Lan empties the cart completely, adds the same three drinks, and orders again with the same reusable test code. The server environment and account conditions remain unchanged, and the second order again shows €23.20. She attaches both failed order IDs to the test sheet, with the input conditions above them. The promotion remains closed. What the developer receives is no longer “checkout seems wrong,” but an order that can be rerun by following the sheet.

She writes the arithmetic out completely. An actual total of €23.20 means only €0.80 was discounted, which is €1.60 less than the expected €2.40 discount. At this point, the test establishes only that the actual result repeatedly disagrees with the rule under these conditions. The test sheet stops there, and only then does the developer inspect the implementation.

During debugging, the developer finds that the code applies the 10% discount to only one €8 drink, exactly accounting for the €0.80 reduction, and changes the implementation. After the new version reaches the test environment, An Lan does not inspect the code; she starts again from an empty cart and reruns the original three-drink case with the test code. The result is now €21.60, confirming the original failure condition no longer appears.

She then expands the same discount boundary. Two €8 drinks at 10% off should be €14.40, checking whether multiple quantities are all included. One €8 drink at 10% off should be €7.20; that path had already been correct under the old implementation. Three drinks without a promotion code should remain €24.00 and had also been correct before. Those latter two become regression checks, while the original three-drink failure is permanently added to the automated suite.

Before opening on Saturday, the owner sees the new €21.60 result on the test sheet and only then enables the promotion entry. An Lan clips the two €23.20 failure orders and the €21.60 confirmation order beneath the register in time order, with the automated-test ID label still visible at the top.
storyParagraphsZh: 咖啡店原定周六早上开放九折预订优惠。周五收店前，安澜用可重复使用的测试优惠码新建空购物车，加入三杯同款饮品，每杯€8。测试规则明确没有税、运费或其他附加费，九折作用于整行小计，因此€24.00应减€2.40，结账总额应是€21.60；页面却显示€23.20。
店主先不开放优惠入口。安澜把购物车完全清空，重新加入同样三杯商品，再用同一可重复测试码下单；服务器环境和账号条件保持不变，第二张订单仍是€23.20。她把两张失败订单号订在测试单上，输入条件写在上方。优惠入口还关着，开发者拿到的已不是一句“结账好像不对”，而是照着这张纸就能重新执行的一单。
她把账算完整：实际€23.20意味着只减了€0.80，比应减的€2.40少€1.60。测试到这里能确定的只是“这一明确条件下，实际结果与规则稳定不符”。测试单停在这里，开发者随后才去检查实现。
开发者调试后发现代码只对一件€8饮品应用了10%折扣，正好解释€0.80，并修改实现。新版本进入测试环境后，安澜再次从空购物车开始，用原来的三杯和测试码重跑；结果变为€21.60，原故障条件得到确认。
她随后扩展同一折扣边界：2杯×€8九折应为€14.40，用来检查多件数量是否都被计入；1杯×€8九折应为€7.20，这条路径在旧实现下本来就正确；三杯不用优惠码时应保持€24.00，也是原本正确的路径。后两项作为回归检查，原来的三杯失败条件被永久放进自动测试。
周六开店前，店主看到测试单上的新€21.60结果，才打开九折优惠入口。安澜把两张€23.20失败单和一张€21.60确认单按时间顺序夹在收银台下，最上面那张自动测试编号贴纸露在外面。
explanationParagraphs: Software testing can use static or dynamic techniques to evaluate work products. This article uses dynamic testing: defined inputs produce actual results that are compared with expectations. Debugging locates causes and changes the implementation; confirmation and regression testing follow the fix.

Here 3×€8=€24, and 10% off gives €24×0.9=€21.60. Two runs instead produce €23.20, a €1.60 discrepancy. Debugging then identifies the one-item discount. After the fix, €14.40 checks the two-item boundary; €7.20 and no-discount €24.00 check previously correct paths.
explanationParagraphsZh: 软件测试通过静态或动态方式评估工作产品；本篇属于动态测试，用明确输入比较预期与实际。调试负责定位原因和修改实现，修复后再做确认与回归检查。
本例3×€8=€24，九折为€24×0.9=€21.60，却两次得€23.20，差€1.60；调试才定位只折一杯。修复后2杯€14.40检查同类边界，1杯€7.20和无折€24.00检查原正确路径。
articles.overallZh: 本篇用动态测试例说明软件测试与反馈：明确条件下比较预期与实际结果，复现差异后把证据交给调试；修复后再确认原故障，并用回归测试检查原本正确的其他路径。软件测试也包括无需执行代码的静态评审等方式，有限通过不能证明无缺陷。

moduleZh.intro: 让优惠是否上线依赖一组可复现账单，同时严格区分失败证据、调试原因、原故障确认和其他路径回归。
moduleZh.diagramTitle: 从两张€23.20失败单到可重复执行的回归条件
diagramSteps: 在无附加费规则下设3×€8、九折、空购物车，预期€21.60
重置购物车和可重复测试码后，同条件第二次仍得€23.20
记录实际只减€0.80、与预期折扣差€1.60，再交给调试
修复后重跑原三杯条件确认€21.60，并检查2杯€14.40

articles.overall: Software testing and feedback use defined expectations and observed results to evaluate software and feed evidence into debugging and change. This article uses a dynamic test example: after reproducing the discrepancy, debugging identifies the cause, confirmation checks the original failure after the fix, and regression checks previously correct paths. Software testing also includes static reviews and analyses that do not execute code, and finite passing tests cannot prove the absence of defects.

module.intro: Make promotion release depend on a reproducible bill, while keeping failure evidence, debugging cause, original-failure confirmation, and regression of existing behavior distinct.

articles.title: 400 Expense Records before 17:00
articles.summary: The finance team needs invoice screening before 17:00. The pairwise method uses 4,950, 19,900, and 79,800 comparisons for 100, 200, and 400 records; faster hardware changes only per-step constants. A hash index processes records under bounded-key, fixed expected lookup, and fixed amortized insertion assumptions. Matching keys still go to human reviewers.
articles.summaryZh: 财务团队17:00前要完成重复发票初筛。配对法对100、200、400条做4,950、19,900、79,800次比较，更快电脑只改单步常数。哈希索引在键长有界、查找期望成本固定、插入摊还成本固定的假设下按记录处理；同键记录仍交人工复核。
storyParagraphs: The month-end payment file must reach the review team by 17:00, and Ji Heng receives 400 expense records that afternoon. The old program compares the normalized “supplier ID + invoice number” of every pair of records; matching keys are placed into a human-review candidate list. Last month, 100 records took about two minutes under that machine and dataset. That experience makes the team first think of switching to a computer that performs the basic comparisons faster.

Ji Heng does not use the old two-minute result to directly predict today’s runtime because the machine, data, and I/O conditions are different. Instead, he fixes a more comparable quantity: one comparison of a pair of normalized invoice keys counts as one basic operation. With n records and each distinct pair compared once, the old program requires exactly n(n−1)/2 comparisons.

For 100 records, that is 4,950 comparisons; for 200, 19,900; for 400, 79,800. Increasing the input from 100 to 400 is a factor of four, while the number of pairs grows by about a factor of sixteen. If the new computer makes the same comparison roughly twice as fast on average, it changes the constant time per step but does not change 79,800 into 19,900. Actual wall-clock time still depends on caching, disk access, and implementation details.

The team tests a hash-index screening version. Each record produces a normalized invoice key, performs a lookup, and inserts the key if it is new. The cost model treats key length as bounded and assumes hashing gives fixed expected lookup cost, while resizing costs spread over many insertions leave fixed amortized insertion cost. Each record needs at most one lookup and one insertion. Under these assumptions, processing grows approximately with n, while storing up to n keys consumes extra memory.

Matching keys enter the yellow candidate list. Reviewers use it to check suppliers, amounts, attachments, and business context; a yellow mark is not a finding of misconduct. On another page, Ji Heng places the pairwise comparison counts beside the index method’s processing units, with key-construction and storage costs listed too. Bounded key length and fixed average lookup cost remain conditions on that page. Different inputs or another index implementation would need a fresh check.

At 16:20, the index screening of 400 records finishes and the yellow list reaches the human review desk. Ji Heng clips the three counts—4,950, 19,900, 79,800—behind the batch sheet and enters 16:20 separately in the handover record. The 17:00 deadline is still printed at the top of the list.
storyParagraphsZh: 月底付款文件17:00要交给复核组，季衡下午拿到400条报销记录。旧程序会把每两条记录的“供应商编号+发票号”比较一次，相同就放进人工复核候选。上个月100条在当时那台机器和数据条件下跑过约2分钟，这个经验让大家先想到了换一台基本比较更快的电脑。
季衡没有拿那2分钟直接外推今天要跑多久，因为机器、数据和I/O条件已经不同。他先固定一个更可比的量：把“比较一对已规范化发票键”算作一次基本操作。n条记录每对只比一次，因此旧程序正好需要n(n−1)/2次比较。
100条需要4,950次，200条19,900次，400条79,800次。输入从100变400是4倍，配对数约变16倍。若新电脑让一次相同比较平均快约2倍，它只改变每一步的常数时间，不会把79,800这个算法步骤数改成19,900；实际钟表时间仍会受缓存、读盘和实现影响。
团队试了一个哈希索引初筛版本。每条记录先构造统一发票键，再查询索引；键没出现过时插入一次。这份成本模型把键长度视为有界，假定散列使查找具有期望固定成本，扩容的插入成本摊在多次操作上后也保持固定量级。每条至多一次查询和一次插入，处理单元随n近似线性增长，同时保存最多n个键。
索引里的同键记录进入黄色候选清单。复核组拿着清单继续看供应商、金额、附件和业务背景，没有把黄色标记当成违规结论。季衡在另一页并列记录配对法的比较次数和索引法的处理单元，并列出构键与存储成本。键长度有界、平均查找成本固定，都是这一页保留的条件，换一种输入或索引实现就要重新核对。
16:20，400条记录的索引初筛实际完成，黄色候选清单送到了人工复核桌。季衡把4,950、19,900、79,800三行计数夹在批次单后面，交付记录上另填了16:20；17:00的截止时间还写在清单页眉上。
explanationParagraphs: Computational complexity studies how algorithmic resource requirements grow with input size, often using asymptotic notation to describe growth scale. Big O gives an upper-bound growth scale; it is not an exact runtime, a guaranteed tight bound, or automatically a lower bound for the problem.

The pairwise method has n(n−1)/2 comparisons. The hash-index example assumes bounded keys, fixed expected lookup cost, and fixed amortized insertion cost before concluding approximately linear processing; key construction, memory, and worst cases still need accounting.
explanationParagraphsZh: 计算复杂度研究算法资源需求怎样随输入规模增长，常用渐近记号描述增长尺度；大O给出上界尺度，不是精确秒数，也不必然表示紧界或问题下界。
配对法有n(n−1)/2次比较。哈希索引例假定键长有界、查找期望成本固定、插入摊还成本固定，处理才近似按n增长；构键、内存和最坏情况仍须核算。

articles.overall: Computational complexity is illustrated here through fictional duplicate-invoice screening: under an explicit basic-operation definition and cost model, it studies how an algorithm’s time steps, storage, or other resource needs grow with input size. Faster hardware can improve constant factors but does not automatically change the growth order; counting steps for one algorithm also does not prove an optimal lower bound for the underlying problem.

module.intro: Fix the basic operation and cost assumptions, analyze growth with exact step counts across multiple input sizes, and keep theoretical counts separate from measured wall-clock time.
module.diagramTitle: How Algorithm Steps Grow from 4,950 to 79,800 as the Record Count Increases
diagramSteps: Define one basic operation as comparing a pair of normalized invoice keys
Use n(n−1)/2 to calculate 4,950/19,900/79,800 comparisons for 100/200/400 records
Separate the roughly 16-fold pair-growth from a roughly 2-fold hardware improvement in per-step speed
Use a hash index with at most one lookup and insertion per record, assuming fixed expected lookup and amortized insertion costs
Record key-construction cost, storage, worst cases, and the actual 16:20 completion time separately
diagramStepNotes: The earlier two-minute run on 100 records is one measurement in an old environment and is not directly extrapolated to 400 records in a new environment.
The exact pair counts belong to this specific algorithm, not to a lower bound for every algorithm.
Hardware changes usually affect constants, not the growth order of the pair-count formula.
Expected cost depends on hashing assumptions; amortized insertion spreads resizing costs across many operations. Neither guarantees unconditional worst-case cost for a single operation.
Big O is an upper-bound growth scale, not an exact runtime or necessarily a tight bound.
mapping: 17:00 payment-file deadline → the business delivery window the team actually cares about.
4,950/19,900/79,800 → exact step counts for the pairwise algorithm.
Faster computer → improvement in a per-step constant.
Yellow candidate list → matching keys trigger human review rather than automatically proving misconduct.
module.boundary: Complexity analysis depends on the basic operation, input representation, and cost model. Key construction, long-key comparison, memory, and I/O are not inherently free; expected or amortized index performance does not imply an unconditional worst-case guarantee. Big O describes upper-bound growth scale. This article does not prove a theoretical lower bound or an optimal algorithm for duplicate detection.
module.reflection: Why does the earlier observation that 100 records took about two minutes fail to determine exactly how long today’s 400 records must take, even though the 79,800 pair count remains exact for the old algorithm?

references.citation: Sedgewick, R., & Wayne, K. Introduction to Programming in Java, section 4.1: Analysis of Algorithms.
references.use: Supports analyzing algorithms through input size, basic-operation counts, and growth rates while distinguishing theoretical step growth from runtime on a particular machine.
